Small, merged before any batch 1 branch is cut, so no later branch edits package.json (except P3-RTE, and only if a dependency is approved) and every client and server test reads one response contract.

(1) package.json: add one script per new suite, each exactly 'node scripts/test-<name>.js' (scripts/run-tests.js fails the gate if any scripts/test-*.js has no matching test:* script or the command differs from that form). Suites and owners: test:logout-preview (P3-SESSION), test:doc-diff (P3-DIFF), test:publish-checks (P3-CHECKS), test:publish-undo (P3-UNDO), test:doc-changes (P3-CHANGES), test:preview-frame (P3-FRAME), test:editor-store (P3-STORE), test:editor-inspector (P3-INSPECTOR), test:editor-tree (P3-TREE), test:publish-ui (P3-PUBLISHUI), test:editor-routes (P3-ROUTES), test:editor-shell (P3-EDITOR), test:design-doc (P3-DESIGN), test:rich-text (P3-RTE). Each new scripts/test-<name>.js prints 'pending: owned by cms/p3-<id>' and exits 0. Each owner later replaces only its own file.

(2) New lib/admin/documents-api-shapes.js: data only, no imports, edge-safe. It is the single contract for the documents API in phase 3. For every operation it exports the HTTP status, the code and every field of each outcome, as one example object per outcome. Copy the existing codes and fields from lib/admin/documents-api.js and lib/documents/*.js exactly (do not rename anything that exists). New entries:
- publish/publishSet 200: items[i] gains liveUrl ('/api/preview?exit=1&to=<path>') and undo {id, revision, logId}; items accept confirmRepublish:true.
- 409 DOCUMENT_CHANGED and PUBLISHED_ELSEWHERE: current {id, revision, draftHash, updatedBy, updatedByName}.
- 409 SLUG_TAKEN: other {id, label}. 409 REPUBLISH_CONFIRM_NEEDED {id}. 409 FIRST_PUBLISH_NEEDS_HOME with offer {publishSet:[{id, revision, draftHash, label}]}. 409 TOO_MANY_KEPT. 409 STORE_USES_LEGACY (also for the two new reads).
- 422 VALIDATION_FAILED: issues[i] gains level ('blocks'|'warns'|'inherited'), anchor, where and actions [{type:'hideSection'|'removeSection'|'removeItem'|'publishBoth', documentId, sectionId?, field?, index?}].
- 422 LINKS_TO_UNPUBLISHED: issues plus offer {publishSet:[{id, revision, draftHash, label}]}.
- 501 NOT_BUILT.
- undo 200 {ok, nothing?, message, savedVersion?:{id, where:'Earlier versions'}, liveUrl, document}; undo/unpublish/undoSet with dryRun:true 200 {willTakeOffline, linkers:[{id,label}], changes:[{words}], target:{versionId, name}|null}.
- unpublish 200 {ok, message, document}. undoSet 200 {ok, message, documents:[…]}.
- listRecentlyPublished 200 {rows:[{logId, setId, documentId, label, action, actionWords, byName, at, summary:[{words}], canUndo, undo:{id, revision, logId}|null, note?}]}.
- listChanges 200 {firstPublish:false, rows:[{kind, sectionId?, words}]} or {firstPublish:true, sections:[{words}]}; doc_design rows may carry affects:[{words}].
- keepLiveSection 200 {document}. keepAsEarlierDraft 200 {savedVersion:{id, note}}.
- getDocument/listDocuments: document.access {canPublish, reason}.
Export also SHAPES_VERSION = 1. Batch 1 and 2 server tests assert their responses against these examples (same keys); P3-SESSION's mapper tests feed these examples to the client.
acceptance: unit: pnpm test is green with every placeholder; run-tests.js reports each new suite as a pass.

items.brief:
Extend the proven commit core, move the build helpers into one shared module, and lay the API for every later item. Gate: batch 2 does not start until test:publish passes on sqld with this branch merged.

(1) New lib/documents/build.js. First a pure move out of lib/documents/publish.js with no behaviour change: readLive, liveFrom, liveEntryOf, readVersionBodies, makeBuild, slugClash, journalIndexOf, failedError, pageRow, redirectsOf, and the rebuild loop (up to MAX_ATTEMPTS with the lost/unknown/failed mapping) as runGuardedBuild(buildFn, context). publish.js imports them; __publishInternals keeps its names. Then extend, all in build.js:
- makeBuild(live, items, ctx): each item may carry action ('publish'|'unpublish'|'undo'), offline:true, draft {body, hash, slug, label}, published {versionId|null, hash|null}, undone (id|null), expectPublished (id|null), extraVersions, undoesLogId, savedVersionId, note.
- offline:true writes the entry with a fresh copy of the last live body, the pages row with enabled:false, or for a journal post the index entry with enabled:false through a new override argument to nextJournalIndexBody(journalBody, posts, {disabled:[documentId]}). The body is not edited, so its documentHash is unchanged. The document's redirects are dropped from list.redirects. A later publish writes them again from the body (existing redirectsOf).
- liveEntryOf: an entry whose pages row or index entry is enabled:false returns {offline:true, liveBody:null, version}. classify then treats the document as not live, so the inherited rule never applies to an offline page.
- slugClash: a disabled entry whose document is archived does not count as taken, and the result lists release:[documentId]; makeBuild removes those entries (setEntries remove). Archive is terminal: no code path sets archived_at back to NULL (assert by a grep test), so no extra guard term is needed.
- draftSlugOwner(slug, exceptId): one statement, SELECT id, label FROM documents WHERE slug = ? AND archived_at IS NULL AND id <> ?.
- After an ok commit, build.js calls every handler in new lib/documents/after-commit.js (export const afterCommit = [] and runAfterCommit({build, items}), best effort, errors logged as 'documents_after_commit_failed', never thrown). It is empty in this batch; P3-DESIGN adds the theme_pin handler.

(2) lib/documents/commit.js, per-document fields:
- draft {body, hash, slug, label, by, at}: the documents UPDATE sets exactly the columns service.draftWrite sets (draft, draft_hash, slug, label, revision = revision + 1, updated_at, updated_by), in the same guarded statement as the pointer fields. A test compares the column sets.
- published {versionId|null, hash|null}. The hash is always documentHash(body) (ids stripped, lib/registry/body.js), never document_versions.body_hash (ids kept). Name this in the code comment.
- undone; expectPublished adds 'AND published_version_id IS ?' to that document's guard.
- extraVersions [{id, kind:'undo_saved', body, hash, by, note}] are kept separate from versions: inserted ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING in the batch, counted by the flip guard, and excluded from liveListHoldsMine and from publish.js's sent/ownBuildIn map. Reconcile of a resent undo-shaped batch is ok through oursPresent; a comment and a test pin this so nobody later 'fixes' liveListHoldsMine.
- refs rows INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; log rows carry action, undoes_log_id and saved_version_id.
- A UNIQUE failure on documents.slug inside the batch maps to refusal code SLUG_TAKEN (409), not DB_REFUSED.

(3) Migration 0023_document_refs.sql, all IF NOT EXISTS: document_refs(version_id, ref_type, ref_id, PRIMARY KEY(all three)); index document_refs_target(ref_type, ref_id); publish_log_set ON publish_log(set_id) WHERE set_id IS NOT NULL; publish_log_undoes ON publish_log(undoes_log_id) WHERE undoes_log_id IS NOT NULL; publish_log_recent ON publish_log(created_at).

(4) Refs presence: hasRefsTable() reads sqlite_master once and caches only a positive answer per tenant in the isolate (a missing table is probed again next publish). That is one statement per publish until 0023 has run, counted in the statement budget. When missing, the build omits the refs statements and logs 'document_refs_missing'; publish and later Undo still succeed. Phase 2 documents versions have no refs rows (no backfill here; P3-HARNESS re-seeds through publish; MIG-01 owns the legacy backfill).

(5) New lib/documents/refs.js (pure, edge-safe): refRows(versionId, body) from registry refsOf() and document settings; ref_type in document, collection, product, media, bundle, offer, quiz; a page link resolves to its document id when it carries one, else 'slug:<family>:<slug>'. linkersStatement(documentId, slugKey): one statement over document_refs JOIN documents ON version_id = published_version_id. makeBuild writes refRows for every fresh published version.

(6) New lib/documents/paths.js (pure): livePath(type, meta): home and every singleton '/'; page '/about' or '/contact' for those slugs, else '/policies/<slug>'; campaign '/campaigns/<slug>'; journal '/journal/<slug>'. liveExitUrl(path) = '/api/preview?exit=1&to=' + encodeURIComponent(path).

(7) lib/admin/documents-api.js, keeping parse (400) -> authorize -> mode (409) -> 428 -> service:
- unpublish {id, revision, dryRun?}, undo {id, revision, logId, dryRun?}, undoSet {setId, members:[{id, logId}], dryRun?} under storefront.publish;
- listRecentlyPublished {limit?: 1..50, default 20} and listChanges {id} under storefront.read;
- keepLiveSection {id, sectionId, revision} and keepAsEarlierDraft {id, body} (no 428) under storefront.write;
- publish and publishSet items accept confirmRepublish:true.
The parser copies dryRun, logId and confirmRepublish; the dispatcher passes the whole parsed op to the module and returns the module's {status, body} as-is, so no batch 2 item edits this file. Mode: writes are checked as today; the two new reads check getCmsMode themselves and answer 409 STORE_USES_LEGACY on legacy or migrating; getDocument and listDocuments keep today's behaviour. getDocument and listDocuments add access {canPublish, reason}; the staff reason: 'Only the store owner or an admin can publish. You can edit and preview.' The UNREADABLE wording for publish operations says '…so nothing was published…'.
Stub modules lib/documents/undo.js (undo, undoSet, unpublish, listRecentlyPublished) and lib/documents/changes.js (listChanges, keepLiveSection, keepAsEarlierDraft) throw NotBuiltError (501 NOT_BUILT). Each stub's header copies its signature and the shapes from lib/admin/documents-api-shapes.js.

(8) lib/platform/export.js: document_refs in EXPORT_TABLES (skipped when missing). scripts/test-schema-compat.js: 0023 constants and a documents tenant at 0022 case.

Legacy: releases.js and the legacy APIs are untouched; test-releases and test-cms-api stay green.

Contract upkeep after batch 0 (read the From review list in docs/cms-reviews/P3-SCAFFOLD.md): in this batch you own lib/admin/documents-api-shapes.js and scripts/test-api-shapes.js. Make the check robust: scan every lib/documents/*.js file (not publish.js alone) so the pure move into build.js keeps it green, and stop pinning the exact text of the dispatcher 200 lines (compare keys instead), so adding access to getDocument/listDocuments is a shapes update, not a red suite. Fix the examples: anchor uses P3-VALIDATE fieldAnchor format (f-<sectionId|doc>-<path with . as ->, e.g. f-sec_hero-title) and where uses the "Banner · Button" form; publish_log.set_id is NOT NULL (drop "setId may be null"); list every publish_log action (publish, unpublish, undo, scheduled, restore, migrated) with actionWords for each; mark updatedBy/updatedByName on publish conflicts optional until P3-CHECKS adds them. Also check the 401/403 wording against lib/admin-auth.js.

items.brief:
New pure module lib/documents/diff.js (edge-safe, no DB), used by P3-CHANGES (listChanges), P3-UNDO (dry-run and Recently published summaries) and the publish-both review.

diffBodies(type, fromBody, toBody) returns rows [{kind, sectionId?, words}] with kind one of added, removed, edited, moved, hidden, shown, meta, settings.
- Sections match by id first; unmatched sections then pair by kind plus stripIds content, so lazily stamped ids never show as changes.
- edited rows name the changed fields by registry labels: 'Banner: button text changed'. Nested paths (buttons.0.label, body.2, items.1.question) use the parent label plus a plain position word only where the registry has no better label ('Text: a paragraph changed').
- meta rows: web address (never the word slug), title, windows, redirects.
- document settings rows from the type's settings labels.
- doc_design: one row per changed token group in plain words ('Colours: accent changed').
- No row text contains a hash, an id, 'slug', 'handle', 'CTA' or 'href'.
firstPublishRows(type, body): what will go live, one row per visible section plus the title.
If fromBody and toBody have equal documentHash, return [].

unit: bodies that differ only by section ids give []; equal documentHash gives [].

items.brief:
lib/documents/publish.js plus new lib/documents/checks.js. Build helpers come from lib/documents/build.js (P3-COMMIT); do not edit build.js.

(1) Reference checks over the set's own bodies only, against M2: the live list with the set applied, the journal index, code-default page slugs, the set's own new slugs, and the collections, products and media tables (at most one IN statement per table, through refsOf()).
- blocks: a hand-placed link (page link, or url to /policies|/campaigns|/journal/<slug>) to a missing or disabled target; a link to a missing collection or product; an empty required text and a missing purchase box (existing); an empty home page; a redirect_from that loops or targets itself.
- warns, with removeItem or removeSection: a deleted or unavailable product in a list; a product_rail collection missing or empty; missing media (token fallback); missing alt text on an image; a redirect_from shadowed by a live page.
- inherited: the existing classify() rule. An offline document (liveEntryOf offline) has liveBody null, so nothing in it is inherited.
Each issue gains level, anchor (fieldAnchor), where (issue-words) and actions: hideSection {documentId, sectionId} for any section-level block, removeSection, removeItem {field, index}, or publishBoth.

(2) A link whose target is an existing, non-archived document not live in M2 gives 422 LINKS_TO_UNPUBLISHED: 'This page links to <label>, which isn't published yet.' offer.publishSet holds the current set plus the targets {id, revision, draftHash, label}. Sending the offer runs the targets' own checks; a failing target gets the normal 422. The client shows each target's changes before the founder confirms (P3-PUBLISHUI); the server needs nothing more because draftHash pins what was reviewed.

(3) Publish again: when an item's draft_hash equals documentHash(body of documents.undone_version_id) (read that one version body; never compare with document_versions.body_hash) and confirmRepublish is not set, answer 409 REPUBLISH_CONFIRM_NEEDED: 'You took this page offline. Publish the same content again?' A successful publish passes undone:null. Add the deferred P22 skip-rule test.

(4) First publish: when the store state is none and the set does not include a publishable doc_home, answer 409 FIRST_PUBLISH_NEEDS_HOME: 'Publish your home page with this, so the store opens with a home page.' with offer.publishSet adding doc_home (until PUB-12 ships; open question).

Replace the stubs in lib/documents/undo.js with the spec 8.6 Undo, built only from lib/documents/build.js (makeBuild overrides, runGuardedBuild, draftSlugOwner, slugClash) and lib/documents/diff.js. Do not edit build.js, commit.js or publish.js.

Target rule. An undoable row is a publish_log row with action publish, unpublish or restore that no 'undo' row references (publish_log_undoes index). 'undo' and 'migrated' rows are never targets. A row is 'current' when it is the document's latest undoable row and the live state still matches it: for publish/restore, documents.published_version_id = to_version_id; for unpublish, published_version_id IS NULL and undone_version_id = from_version_id.

undo({id, revision, logId, dryRun, actor}):
1. Read the row by logId. If it is not current, answer 409 PUBLISHED_ELSEWHERE ('This was changed after that publish. Reload to see the latest.') with current.
2. Floors: a 'migrated' row, or no row: 200 {nothing:true, message:'There's nothing earlier to undo.'}. Target = from_version_id. A null target on a singleton: 200 {nothing:true, message:'This is the first published version. Edit it, or go back to your starting design.'}. A null target on a page, campaign or post: take offline.
3. Target body = upgradeBody(target version body) (spec 8.7 step 6), so the draft and the fresh version are in the current schema.
4. Slug: if the target meta.slug differs from the current draft slug, check slugClash against the live list and draftSlugOwner against other drafts; a clash is 409 SLUG_TAKEN naming that page with nothing written. Reference checks are skipped.
5. If the current draft's draft_hash differs from both the live hash and documentHash(target), add an extraVersions undo_saved row of the current draft with the note 'Saved before Undo'.
6. One guarded build through makeBuild: a fresh published version copying the target body; entry, pages row or journal index entry and redirects from the target meta; draft {body: target, hash, slug, label}; published {versionId, hash: documentHash(target)}; undone null; expectPublished = the row's live version; an 'undo' log row with undoes_log_id = logId and saved_version_id; refs for the fresh version.
   Take offline: action 'undo', offline:true, draft unchanged, published null, undone = the live version, expectPublished = live version. The response says how to bring it back: 'It's offline now. To bring it back, open it and publish it again.'
   Undo of an 'unpublish' row: the target is that row's from_version_id; the build re-enables the entry, writes redirects and refs, sets published to the fresh version, clears undone, and keeps the draft as it is (the draft never changed when the page went offline).
7. runGuardedBuild: on lost, re-check step 1 (still current) and rebuild, up to 3 times; when the row is no longer current answer 409 PUBLISHED_ELSEWHERE; after 3 losses 409 DOCUMENT_CHANGED; unknown 503. No undo_saved orphan can survive a lost attempt (it is in the batch).
Response: {ok, message naming what changed, savedVersion?:{id, where:'Earlier versions'}, liveUrl, document}.

dryRun:true on undo, unpublish or undoSet writes nothing and returns {willTakeOffline, linkers:[{id,label}] from linkersStatement, changes: diffBodies(type, live body, target body) words, target:{versionId, name}}.

unpublish({id, revision}): take offline as its own publish with action 'unpublish', guarded by expectPublished = the live version. Refused for singletons: 'This part of the store can't be taken offline.'

undoSet({setId, members:[{id, logId}]}): every member's row must be current (else 409 PUBLISHED_ELSEWHERE naming the member, nothing changes). Read each member's current revision and guard on it in the batch; a member whose draft diverges from both live and target gets its own undo_saved row. One build for all members, all-or-none.

listRecentlyPublished({limit}): publish_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT n, joined to documents.label, names via versions.namesFor, action words ('Published', 'Took offline', 'Undid'), grouped by set_id. Each row carries summary = diffBodies(from body, to body) (bodies fetched in one IN statement), canUndo true only when the row is current, and undo args {id, revision, logId}. - server-replace operations (undo, keepLiveSection, discardDraft for 'Go back to the live version', restoreVersion): flush() pending edits first, then hold autosave during the call. The response's document replaces the local body and revision. Edits made during the hold are recorded as field-path operations and replayed on top of the new body, then saved; never a stale full-body overwrite.
- publish and publishSet: flush, hold, then publish with the acked draftHash.
